snippet.title: Just 30mins From Tokyo: KAWAGOE Historic Town Food Tour!
snippet.description:
Looking for a great adventure in Japan? Find hundreds of bookable food experiences here: https://bit.ly/4agznyx

Just an hour away from Tokyo in Saitama, Kawagoe's cobbled streets, well-preserved historical architecture, and nostalgic ambiance transport visitors back to a bygone era. Often referred to as ‘Koedo’ or ‘Little Edo,’ this charming city resonates with the spirit of Japan's Edo period.

Join Shizuka as she steps back in time and journeys to old-world Japan! The adventure begins at Kawagoe's iconic Toki no Kane bell tower, dating back to 1639. Next, our host craves Kawagoe-style street food, which she tracks down at Koedo Osatsuan, a shop known for its sweet potato chips dipped in cream! 

Sweet tooth activated, Shizuka strolls to her next destination… Kawagoe Cheese Cake. But which flavor will she choose? Kawagoe Sweet Potato Cheese Cake Mont Blanc, of course! Fuelled and ready to continue the journey, Shizuka makes her way to an unagi (eel) shop, another Kawagoe specialty. She tried a regional delicacy called Umaki, which combines the words ‘unagi’ (eel) and ‘tamagoyaki’ (Japanese rolled omelet).

Seeking some solace from the summer heat, Shizuka searches for a snack to cool her down, which presents itself in the form of Kyuri Asazuke (chilled pickled cucumber). Our host strolls on to Kashiya Yokocho for some more nostalgic sweet treats. Stop number one is an 85cm Fugashi (a dried wheat gluten snack coated in sugarcane sugar). Stop two sees Shizuka try her hand at candy glass blowing! Stop three involves an ice cold Coedo Beer, the perfect way to end the day.

一緒に行った人と競ってみて！

snippet.title: [Kintaro Ukiyo-e Life] Experience Japan's Tanabata Star Festival: Tokyo & Kawagoe Tour! | en-Spring-
snippet.description:
"Kintaro Ukiyo-e Life" is a show where Rakugo performer Kintaro introduces Japanese culture to the world.
In this episode, we'll introduce Tanabata (the Star Festival), a traditional Japanese event that has continued since the Nara period!
Join us as we visit various spots in Tokyo to experience the custom of writing wishes on "tanzaku" (strips of paper), hanging them on bamboo branches, and then performing "otakiage" (a ceremonial burning of wishes).

Highlights of this video:
*   **Shiba Park**: Learn the basics of Tanabata decorations with Tokyo Tower as a stunning backdrop.
*   **Imperial Hotel**: Admire elegant and sophisticated Tanabata decorations.
*   **Ginza Kyukyodo**: Discover the unique and convenient tanzaku display method, perfect for a stationery store!
*   **Tokyo Daijingu**: A shrine famous for matchmaking, where you'll be amazed by the countless tanzaku filled with heartfelt wishes. We'll also introduce beautiful wind chimes and ema (votive tablets).
*   **Kawagoe Hikawa Shrine**: At this 1500-year-old shrine, experience the unique "Enmusubi Furin" (Matchmaking Wind Chimes) Tanabata display, where wishes are hung on wind chimes instead of traditional bamboo.

While Tanabata is celebrated on July 7th in Tokyo, some regions in Tohoku celebrate it in August. Please see the description box for more details.
This video continues in Part 2! We'll explore the origins of Tanabata and introduce even more famous spots, so be sure to watch the next part!

snippet.title: 【JAPAN 4K】 Magnificent Floats at Kawagoe Festival! 🏮👘 / #jvt #kawagoe #4k
snippet.description:
Experiencing the traditional grandeur of the UNESCO-listed Kawagoe Festival (Kawagoe Hikawa Matsuri) in Saitama! 🏮👘 Watch the gorgeous, festival floats (dashi) and lively crowds parade through the historic warehouse district in crystal-clear 4K POV Shorts! ✨🍃
​💡 Historical Context & Event Info:
The Kawagoe Festival is a breathtaking traditional event boasting over 370 years of history, deeply rooted in the Edo period's "Tenka Matsuri" culture! 🏮👘 Registered as a UNESCO Intangible Cultural Heritage, gorgeous two-story float structures featuring historical dolls parade through the old-fashioned "Kurazukuri" (clay-walled warehouse) streets, accompanied by spirited flute and drum music (Kawagoe Bayashi). Enjoy the timeless magic of Koedo (Little Edo) Tokyo's neighboring historic town! 🇯🇵✨
​#japan #kawagoe #kawagoefestival #koedo #matsuri #festivalfloats #saitamatravel #shorts #4k #jvt #dji #pov #google #日本 #川越 #川越まつり #川越氷川祭 #小江戸 #山車 #お祭り #ユネスコ無形文化遺産 #埼玉県 #川越観光 #ショート動画 #POV動画 #日本
​ユネスコ無形文化遺産にも登録されている埼玉・川越の秋の大祭「川越まつり（川越氷川祭）」の絢爛豪華な山車（だし）を捉えたShorts動画です！🏮👘 小江戸・川越の歴史ある蔵造りの町並みを巡行する伝統美と圧倒的な熱気を、高画質4K POV映像でお届けします！✨🍃
​💡 川越まつりの歴史と見どころ：
江戸時代の「天下祭り」の祭礼風俗を現在に伝える、370年以上の歴史を誇る壮大な伝統行事！🏮👘 人形を載せた豪華な二層式の山車が、お囃子（川越囃子）の音色とともに古い町並みを行き交う姿は圧巻の一言。昼夜を通して多くの人々で賑わう、小江戸・川越の最高潮の盛り上がりをお楽しみください！🇯🇵✨

snippet.title: 埼玉県川越市大正浪漫夢通りライブカメラ
snippet.description:
川越市は、埼玉県の北西部に位置し、歴史と伝統、そして現代が見事に融合する、まさに唯一無二の景観が広がる都市です。

この地域の景色は、江戸時代の町並みと現代の都市機能、豊かな自然環境が織りなす、他では見られない特別な風景を生み出しています。

 

四季の変化が鮮明に表現される川越の景色は、まさに日本の歴史と自然の芸術作品と言えるでしょう

。春には、川越城址公園の桜並木が淡いピンクの花を咲かせ、伝統的な蔵造りの町並みと見事に調和します。

特に、小江戸と呼ばれる川越の歴史的町並みに咲く桜は、まさに川越にしか存在しない唯一無二の風景です。

 

夏は、伝統的な蔵造りの町並みと近代的な都市景観が融合した景色が広がります。

川越の中心市街地では、歴史的な建造物と現代の建築が共存し、まるで絵はがきのような美しさを醸し出します。

特に夕暮れ時の蔵造りの街並みは、他では見られない独特の魅力を放っています。

 

秋になると、川越市内の寺社や公園が鮮やかな紅葉に染まります。

特に、喜多院や川越城址公園の紅葉は、まるで自然が描いた絵画のようで、歴史的な建造物と紅葉のコントラストは息をのむほどの美しさです。

 

冬は、伝統的な町並みと雪景色が、静寂と美しさを演出します。

蔵造りの町並みに雪が積もる様子は、まさに川越にしか存在しない、唯一無二の景観を作り出します。

 

歴史と伝統、そして現代が見事に融合する川越景観をお楽しみください。

 
 

※撮影された映像は、個人情報保護の観点から、解像度を落として配信しています。

また、システムの不具合や混雑による電波状況の悪化により、配信が一時停止することがあります。

概ね数時間で配信が復旧しますので、しばらく時間を空けてアクセスしてください。

snippet.title: วิธีไปคาวาโกเอะ (Kawagoe, Tokyo) | Japan Tips 15
snippet.description:
พาสที่ใช้คือ Kawagoe Discount Pass เป็นพาสของสาย Tobu จะมีแบบเฉพาะรถไฟไปกลับ และแบบรวมบัสใน Kawagoe ด้วย

เวลาซื้อตั๋วให้ไปที่ Tobu Tourist Information Center ที่สถานี Ikebukuro

ซื้อตั๋วแล้ว ก็ไปที่ Platform 1 หรือ 2 ขึ้นได้ทุกสาย  แต่ถ้าเลือกได้ให้เลือกสีม่วงคือ Limited Express เพราะมันจะจอดน้อยสุด

แต่ให้ระวังตอนขากลับ ต้องกลับรถไฟคันที่เขียนว่าไป Ikebukuro เท่านั้น

เมื่อไปถึงสถานี Kawagoe แล้ว ก็มีสองทางเลือกคือ ขึ้นบัส หรือเดิน(30 นาที)  แล้วแต่ว่าใครซื้อตั๋วแบบไหนมานะ  

แนะนำว่าถ้าใครไม่ชอบเดิน และต้องทำเวลาก็นั่งบัสไป

snippet.title: Escapada histórica a Kawagoe: el Japón más feudal muy cerca de Tokyo, ¡mucho para ver! Japón Japan
snippet.description:
[ES] Para quién crea que en Tokio y sus alrededores es difícil escapar de la modernidad, quizá sea porque no conoce Kawagoe, en la vecina prefectura de Saitama. Esta ciudad, a la que se llega en menos de una hora en tren de cercanías desde el centro de Tokio, conserva la apariencia del histórico período Edo: el Japón medieval de siglos atrás. En este recorrido visitaremos a lo largo de medio día un sinfín de ubicaciones a lo largo del barrio más histórico de Kawagoe: santuarios y templos, tiendas llenas de encanto, y multitud de edificios con fachadas que evocan un viaje al pasado.

[EN] For those who think that it is difficult to escape modernity in Tokyo and its surroundings, it may be because they do not know Kawagoe, in the neighboring prefecture of Saitama. This city, which can be reached in less than an hour by commuter train from the center of Tokyo, preserves the appearance of the historic Edo period: medieval Japan from centuries ago. On this half-day tour we will visit countless locations throughout the most historic district of Kawagoe: shrines and temples, charming shops, and a multitude of buildings with facades that evoke a trip to the past.

snippet.title: 川越市駅から本川越駅の街並み
snippet.description:
東武東上線の川越市駅から西武新宿線の本川越駅まで歩きました。
本川越駅では2026年1月13日に駅直結の商業施設・プリンスペペが閉店しました。本川越駅の駅ビルは少し寂しい雰囲気でした。駅ホームにあったプリンスペペ直結の改札口につながる階段は塞がれていました。
また、主に特急が使う2番ホームでは末端部で工事をしていました。来年2027年に、特急がライナーに置き換えられるというニュースが出たばかりですが、ライナーの両数が長くなるのに合わせてホームを延長しているのでしょうか。
2026年3月の映像です。

snippet.title: Saitama Kawagoe - 川越 - 4K Ultra HD
snippet.description:
Saitama Kawagoe - 川越 - 4K Ultra HD : Located outside of Tokyo and just barely 30 minutes away from Tokyo central train station, Kawagoe has been made famous over the centuries for its Kurazukuri buildings (warehouses) from the Edo Period and its many suppliers of commodities to the people of Tokyo. Thanks to its many businesses and its strategical purpose, past Shoguns installed many of their most loyal men and lords in Kawagoe and its castle to secure this strategic business hub.

Today however, Kawagoe has lost its purpose and became, with time, a nice little tourist attraction outside of Tokyo that offers many nice souvenirs and Japanese treats. While it still features some stunning Edo designed buildings, the main historic street is today unfortunately disfigured by the wrath of heavy traffic. The non-stop onslaught of buses and trucks all day long annihilate any hope of enjoying this otherwise truly fantastic and well preserved “Little Edo”.

snippet.title: Spring in Japan | Day Trip to Kawagoe Old Town | Cherry Blossom, Shrine & Onigiri Bento | Japan Vlog
snippet.description:
This is a Japan travel vlog exploring spring in Japan and one of the best day trips near Tokyo. In this video, I visited Kawagoe Old Town, just 30 minutes from Tokyo, to experience cherry blossoms, traditional culture, and local food.

I started at Hikawa Shrine in Kawagoe, a well-known spot especially during spring. The Kawagoe Spring Festival was on, and about 100 cherry blossom trees were in bloom along the Shingashi River behind the shrine.

Walking through the famous Ema Tunnel, surrounded by wooden prayer plaques, felt like a unique cultural experience. I was also lucky to see a traditional Japanese wedding ceremony, which made the visit even more special.

One of the highlights was the beautiful view of pink cherry blossoms and bright yellow rapeseed flowers along the river. The scenery looked just like a painting and felt incredibly peaceful.

During the trip, I picked up a simple onigiri bento and enjoyed it on a bench by the river, taking in the calm spring atmosphere.

If you’re looking for cherry blossoms near Tokyo, Kawagoe Old Town, traditional shrines in Japan, or easy day trips from Tokyo, this Japan vlog will give you great ideas.

snippet.title: Visit old-timey Japan just 1 hour from Tokyo | Kawagoe, Japan
snippet.description:
Kawagoe is less than an hour from Tokyo, and is full of so many things to do that it makes for a perfect day-trip, especially if you can't make it to Kyoto. It has old-timey streets, plenty of shopping and street food, and you can rent kimono and yukata there, too.
Kawagoe is famous for sweet potatoes, so make sure you visit some of the local shops selling sweet potato goods and pick up a few things to try or take home!

snippet.title: Indoor activities to escape the heat in Japan #japantravel #tokyo #indooractivities #museum #craft
snippet.description:
15 UNIQUE INDOOR IDEAS TO ESCAPE THE JAPANESE SUMMER HEAT (Part 2: Food & Culture) 🍧👇

Want to escape the heat while still exploring the best of Japan? For Part 2, we are diving into unique indoor and food experiences to keep you cool:

6. Treat yourself to Kakigori 🍧
Pure summer fluff! Find this iconic shaved ice at spots like Hoshino Coffee, or head to Yelo which is opened 24/7!

7. Craft your own Food Models 🎛️
Beat the sun by making your own realistic wax food displays. It’s a super fun look into Japanese design and inclusivity!

8. Try the Art of Amezaiku 🍭
Step into a cool workshop and learn to sculpt heated sugar into beautiful animal shapes with talented traditional artists.

9. Discover the Science of Umami 🧪
Escape the humidity in a museum entirely dedicated to Japan's rich food history and the secrets behind "umami".

10. Visit a Soy Sauce Theme Park 🥢
Yes, a theme park for soy sauce in Kawagoe! The perfect indoor spot to learn how Japan’s favorite condiment is traditionally made.

💾 Save this post for your trip, and check out Part 1 for more ideas!
Don’t miss Part 3 that is coming very soon! 🔥
